incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired: PD-8241 — inference-sharedpool (us-west-2) queue length > 10k, p95 token latency spike. Auto-escalation to eng-oncall.

pagerduty: PD-8241 triggered at 2025-05-01T14:20:54Z — page sent to @Kai (primary).

Kai: ack — oncall here, looking.

Maria: I'm seeing a sustained backlog on the inference dispatcher, queue depth ~11.4k, processing rate dropped ~60%. p95 generation latency 2.8s -> 6.1s for short requests.

Tony: cloud provider reports repeated failures provisioning GPU instances for the shared pool (spot errors + quota rejections). It's failing at node alloc step.

Kai: logs from scaler show repeated "ProvisionTimeout" and "InsufficientInstanceCapacity". Autoscaler health checks passing but scale-up attempts aren't completing.

Maria: quick snapshot from metrics: cpu backpressure low, but KV cache miss rate up 3x — looks like a cold-start surge of embeddings from a legacy batch job.

Kai: runbook check: trying manual spin-up to bypass spot path, will add a reserved instance to warm the pool.

Tony: manual commands — I'm going to create a small on-demand pool and attach it to the sharedpool ASG.

Tony: ```
# create fallback node group (on-demand)
aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name sharedpool-asg --desired-capacity 6 --max-size 12
# increase provider provision timeout
kubectl -n infra patch deployment autoscaler --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"autoscaler","env":[{"name":"PROVISION_TIMEOUT_SECS","value":"600"}] }]}}}}'
```

Kai: doing a targeted scale using the console now, attaching new nodes to the serving-subnet. Will post when healthy.

Maria: tagging customers: error rate for /v1/embed spiked, rate limiting observed at edge. Product impact: some customers see 503/504 and long-running requests. No data loss — best-effort degrade.

Sara: @Kai @Maria thanks — I'm drafting a customer-facing status note: "Experiencing elevated latencies and temporary errors for embedding requests in us-west-2. Engineers are actively mitigating; next update in 15m." Want to review before posting.

Kai: confirmed new on-demand nodes started attaching, kubelet registrations incoming. Watching dispatcher drain: backlog has gone from 11.4k -> 6.2k in last 90s.

Tony: also flipped autoscaler fallback policy to allow CPU-backed nodes for low-priority workloads to free GPUs for inference-critical pods. Patched nodeSelector on fallback deployment.

Maria: rolling restart of dispatcher replicas to rebalance connections. Command: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/dispatcher` — doing that now.

Kai: dispatcher pods back and healthy. Queue continues to decline, now ~2.1k. P95 latency down to 3.2s.

Maria: root cause hypothesis: a scheduled legacy embedding batch (customer job id 0x4f7) started large concurrent prefix loads, causing KV cache churn and a cold-start spike that combined with spot allocation failures to saturate the shared pool.

Tony: follow-ups: 1) request quota increase for GPU spot fallback in us-west-2, 2) add a short-term reserved warm pool, 3) make autoscaler more aggressive for rapid transient spikes (shorter cooldown/enable predictive warmup).

Kai: mitigation checklist done for now: manual on-demand nodes up, autoscaler fallback engaged, dispatcher restart, monitoring in high-sensitivity mode.

Maria: customer impact assessment: high for a small number of customers (embedding-heavy), medium for others due to throttling. No SLO breach yet but risk window was ~12m.

Sara: I'll send the interim update to affected customers with the draft and link to status.

Kai: leaving a postmortem stub and runbook update ticket: will add details about the legacy batch case and a permanent warm pool recommendation.

Maria: tagging Eng-SRE and Infra oncall to follow up. If we don't reach steady-state in 30m, escalate to oncall rotation lead.

Kai: handing off to next oncall @Maria — I'll stay reachable for 10m for any questions. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-8241 status: acknowledged by Kai at 2025-05-01T14:21:10Z.

pagerduty: PD-8241 will auto-escalate at 2025-05-01T14:41:10Z if not resolved.

Sara: posted public status update at 14:28Z. Added note: "Mitigation in place; observing reductions in queue depth. No ETA on full recovery."

Tony: created infra task INFRA-1127 for reserved warm pool and quota request; added to 24h priority.

Maria: leaving monitoring alerts enabled (tight thresholds). Will update when we confirm steady-state for 1h.

Kai: final note before handoff: backlog trimmed, latency trending down, keep PD open until metrics stable for 30m.

Sara: acknowledged. Closing handoff. :white_check_mark:
